import collections,json,re
from pathlib import Path
a=Path("analysis")
old=(a/"initial.json").read_bytes()
new=(a/"final.json").read_bytes()
prefix=old[:old.rfind(b"]")].rstrip()
assert new.startswith(prefix+b",\n")
for report in (a/"review.md",a/"summary.md"):
 assert report.stat().st_size
 for link in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",report.read_text()):
  assert (report.parent/link.split("#")[0]).is_file(), link
d=json.loads((a/"draft-verify.json").read_bytes())
j=json.loads((a/"final-jev.json").read_bytes())
print("Historical rows are an unchanged byte prefix. All review and summary file links resolve.")
print("Draft:", len(d["claims"]), "claims and", len(d["questions"]), "questions.")
print("Final batch:", dict(collections.Counter(x["choice"] for x in j["checks"].values())))
